content.principle: Une recette est un programme culinaire traçable: une identité de famille, une formulation versionnée, des occurrences documentaires, un DAG de matière/états/opérations et des observations d'exécution restent séparés. Les facettes, fingerprints, similarités, espaces de variantes, substitutions, diagnostics et agrégats sont des projections reconstruisibles.
epistemic_boundaries: synthetic seed is not culinary truth
derived projection is not source truth
declared cultural context is not inferred from ingredients alone
quantity normalization never assumes density without an explicit rule
substitution is contextual and never universal equivalence
failure candidate is not a confirmed cause
sensory target is not an observed sensory outcome
food-safety suitability is never inferred from an unsourced ingredient rule
RecipeFamily is a reviewed identity hypothesis over variants, not a folder
all indexes, fingerprints and recommendation surfaces are disposable projections

invariants.rule: RecipeVariant procedure graph must be acyclic
every terminal output must resolve to a graph node
every edge endpoint must resolve to a graph node
every ingredient_ref and technique_ref must resolve to a controlled concept
cultural_context must not be inferred solely from ingredient presence
substitution rule must carry context or be explicitly marked broad
substitution != nutritional, allergen, cultural or sensory equivalence
food-safety suitability must not be derived from unsourced seed metadata
mechanism projection must be traceable to an operation or explicit technique rule
preparation observations append history; they do not rewrite the canonical recipe
family variation statistics describe observed members only, not normative boundaries
scale transformation may alter time, geometry and heat transfer; quantity multiplication alone is not universal scaling
